title: Final Phase Shift
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the final expression for the phase shift delta(k) as k approaches infinity.

title: Matching Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the matching equation for delta_0 from the continuity condition of the wavefunction.

title: Energy Dependence
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the relationship between k' and k in terms of energy and potential.

title: Born Approximation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the Born approximation to find the phase shift for l = 0.

title: Limit Behavior
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss the limiting behavior of the phase shift as k approaches infinity.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign errors in the expressions for k' and k.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.
